meta.scope: Syria Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. Central Bureau of Statistics, population, national accounts, CPI, Central Bank of Syria institutional core, BOP. Population ~26–27 million. Data environment extremely constrained by prolonged conflict and institutional disruption.

candidates.title: Central Bureau of Statistics (Syria) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office. Prolonged conflict has severely disrupted compilation capacity, coverage and continuity; many series rely on external estimates and reconstruction-era monitoring.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node under extreme capacity and coverage constraints.

candidates.title: Population estimates
candidates.description: Population estimates. Population is approximately 26–27 million inside the country; large-scale displacement (internal and external) remains a defining demographic feature.
candidates.notes: Core demographic node. Population ~26–27 million; displacement is structural.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Syria (GDP)
candidates.description: National accounts and GDP estimates. The economy contracted catastrophically during the conflict; recovery remains partial and data quality is limited. External estimates are widely used for surveillance.
candidates.notes: Primary macroeconomic output node under severe data constraints.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been extremely elevated and volatile under currency collapse, supply disruption and monetary financing pressures.
candidates.notes: Core high-frequency price node under extreme inflation conditions.

candidates.title: Central Bank of Syria institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, exchange-rate management and limited macro-financial statistics. Institutional continuity has been disrupted by conflict and political transition; the Syrian pound has depreciated massively from pre-war levels.
candidates.notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart under severe constraint and transition.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of Syria / external estimates
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics where available. Formal trade and capital flows are limited; remittances, humanitarian inflows and informal channels dominate the external position.
referenced_by: Central Bank monetary and external analysis
candidates.notes: External-accounts node under constrained formal data and large informal/humanitarian flows.

candidates.title: Syria foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from CBS and Central Bank sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the CBS institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, Central Bank institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Syrian research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node. Extreme conflict, data gaps and institutional disruption should be carried forward in all subsequent batches.
